Name: OO's Anime Style Skimpy Portraits
Author: TwoCircles
Description:
This mod is inspired by Mud's Super Skimpy portrait and I recommend using it with that mod!

The NPCs that change the portrait and Sprite in this mode are Lewis, Caroline, Evelyn, Marnie, Robin, Gus, Pam, Jodi, Clint, Willy, Wizard, Linus, and Sandy.
It includes summer, winter, and beach outfits.

It's not compatible with other romance modes, and I have plans to do it compatible. I'm going to increase other characters in the future, but it's probably only for vanilla characters.
